Hey Reviewers, the Gimbalabs community has decided to focus on deep work for the summer, which involves suspending live spaces, including Open Spaces, Go Live Coding, Aiken Live Coding, and Dev Standup.
In the current version of the evidence, I added an additional 2 sessions per space (excluding open spaces).
For the final Milestone, we'd be falling short of a couple of videos per space.
I was wondering if you'd be open to substituting the previously approved spaces for M4 with other recorded spaces.
Currently, we have multiple proposals approved for the summer that can be potential substitutions:
Community Code Review: This will potentially include weekly live spaces, but the scheduling is subject to change based on the team's decisions.
African Developers Initiative: Will have recorded workshops.
Odin's Summer of Collaboration: Might potentially have recorded stand-ups and review sessions. Subject to decisions made by the Odin community.
PPBL 2025 Video Updates: Will have recorded videos but not live spaces.

Note: I added the same details to the discussion chat provided. Please feel free to ask further questions or let me know how we can move forward with this proposal. Thank you!
